title: Phi-4-reasoning-vision-15B Technical Report
authors_zh: Jyoti Aneja、Michael Harrison、Neel Joshi、Tyler LaBonte、John Langford、Eduardo Salinas
paper_type_zh: 前沿多模态推理技术报告与数据披露台账
best_for_zh: 需要审查多模态推理模型的数据构造、混合思考模式、反馈边界与可复现性缺口的读者
one_line: Phi-4-reasoning-vision-15B reports a 200B-token, three-stage mixed-reasoning SFT pipeline with public source families and data-quality transformations, but withholds training records, internal/acquired data, verification details, and full audit artifacts.
Phi-4-reasoning-vision-15B 披露了约 200B token、三阶段混合推理 SFT、公开源类别与数据质量转换，但未发布训练记录、内部/采购数据、验证细节或完整审计工件。
why: It shows how a frontier report can disclose useful construction interfaces without turning public weights, aggregate counts, or a source list into evidence of reproducible data lineage, feedback, rights, or auditability.
inclusion_reason: A detailed frontier multimodal reasoning report that discloses stage counts, public source families, filtering/synthetic transformations, mixed reasoning modes, and safety data while retaining material release and audit gaps.

title: Problem
问题
html:
Open-weight multimodal releases can disclose aggregate tokens, model weights, and an appealing training narrative without making their post-training data pipeline reproducible. For a reasoning model, provenance, prompt formats, generated traces, corrections, filters, verifier behavior, retained and rejected records, rights, and contamination controls determine whether a reported recipe can be independently audited or reused.

Phi-4-reasoning-vision-15B is valuable for Track 12 because Microsoft discloses substantially more stage-level construction information than a typical model announcement: a three-stage SFT curriculum, data-quality interventions, public source families, a mixed reasoning/direct-response format, and safety data. The same report retains material boundaries around internal and acquired data, source weights, generated records, verification details, and audit artifacts. This Card records both sides of that disclosure rather than treating public weights or aggregate counts as a released dataset.

开放权重多模态发布可以披露汇总 token、模型权重和具有吸引力的训练叙述，却不一定使后训练数据流水线可复现。对于推理模型，来源、提示格式、生成轨迹、纠错、过滤、verifier 行为、保留与拒绝记录、权利和污染控制，决定了报告的配方能否被独立审计或复用。

Phi-4-reasoning-vision-15B 对 Track 12 有价值，因为 Microsoft 披露的阶段级构造信息多于一般模型公告：三阶段 SFT 课程、数据质量干预、公开来源类别、混合推理/直接回答格式和安全数据。同一报告仍保留内部与采购数据、来源权重、生成记录、验证细节和审计工件等重要边界。本 Card 同时记录两面，而不会把公开权重或汇总计数当作已发布数据集。

title: Core idea
核心思路
html:
Phi-4-reasoning-vision-15B combines the Phi-4-Reasoning language backbone with a SigLIP-2 vision encoder through a mid-fusion MLP. Microsoft reports about 200B multimodal training tokens and three stages: MLP image-text alignment, full-model single-image instruction tuning, then long-context, multi-image, and responsible-AI specialization. The report gives stage sample and token totals of 2.0M/1.4B, 62.8M/188.5B, and 3.2M/12B, respectively.

The model is trained with SFT on a hybrid mixture. Reasoning examples contain a think control token, a chain of thought, and a final answer; direct-response examples begin with a nothink control token. Reasoning data is about 20% of the mixture. Data construction combines filtered and repaired public data with Microsoft internal data and targeted acquisitions, then adds regenerated captions/answers and programmatic image-text transformations. The release does not make the records, exact mixture, or complete quality-control stack available.

Phi-4-reasoning-vision-15B 通过中融合 MLP 将 Phi-4-Reasoning 语言基座与 SigLIP-2 视觉编码器结合。Microsoft 报告约 200B 多模态训练 token 和三个阶段：MLP 图文对齐、全模型单图 instruction tuning、长上下文/多图/负责 AI 专项训练。报告给出的各阶段样本/token 总量分别为 2.0M/1.4B、62.8M/188.5B 和 3.2M/12B。

模型使用混合数据进行 SFT。推理样本含 think 控制 token、思维链和最终答案；直接回答样本以 nothink 控制 token 开始。推理数据约占混合数据的 20%。数据构造将经过过滤和修复的公开数据与 Microsoft 内部数据、定向采购数据结合，再加入重写的 caption/answer 和程序化图文转换。发布并未提供这些记录、精确混合比例或完整质量控制栈。

title: Method
方法
html:
Stage 1 trains only the cross-modal MLP on clean image-captioning data while the vision encoder and language model are frozen. Stage 2 trains all components on single-image instruction data spanning VQA, mathematics and science reasoning, grounding, captioning, OCR, and computer use. Stage 3 continues full-model training on long-document, multi-image, sequential-image, and responsible-AI data. Microsoft reports AdamW, bf16 mixed precision, DeepSpeed ZeRO-1, and one epoch in every stage, but not full learning-rate values or reproducible configurations.

For quality control, reviewers classify datasets as excellent, wrong-answer or poor-caption, low-quality-question, low-quality-image, or formatting/logical-error cases. Excellent data is largely retained; some incorrect answers/captions are regenerated with GPT-4o and o4-mini, which are also used where appropriate in verification or majority-voting pipelines; high-error datasets and fundamentally flawed images are excluded. The report also describes image-seeded caption/VQA generation, detailed math/science image descriptions, scrambled/caption-matching multi-image examples, sequential screenshot changes, and prompt diversification. Exact prompts, teacher allocation, thresholds, error rates, and yields are undisclosed.

阶段 1 仅在干净的图像 caption 数据上训练跨模态 MLP，视觉编码器和语言模型保持冻结。阶段 2 在单图 instruction 数据上训练所有组件，覆盖 VQA、数学和科学推理、grounding、captioning、OCR 与 computer use。阶段 3 继续全模型训练，使用长文档、多图、序列图像和负责 AI 数据。Microsoft 报告了 AdamW、bf16 mixed precision、DeepSpeed ZeRO-1 和每阶段一个 epoch，但没有提供完整学习率数值或可复现实验配置。

对于质量控制，审阅者将数据集归为优质、答案错误或 caption 较差、问题质量低、图像质量低、以及格式/逻辑错误。优质数据大多保留；部分错误答案/caption 由 GPT-4o 和 o4-mini 重写，二者也在适当情况下用于验证或 majority-voting 流水线；高错误率数据集和根本有缺陷的图像会被排除。报告还描述了由图像出发生成 caption/VQA、数学/科学图像详细描述、scrambled/caption-matching 多图示例、序列截图变化和提示多样化。精确提示、teacher 分配、阈值、错误率和产出均未披露。

title: Evidence
证据
html:
The author technical report and Microsoft Research publication directly support the title, authors, MSR-TR-2026-10 identifier, three-stage recipe, stage counts, 200B-token statement, data-quality procedure, mixed reasoning/direct-response format, safety data, and the public-source appendix. The appendix names public source families across alignment, captioning, document QA, OCR, mathematics, CUA, and RAI, while the report separately states that internal and acquired data are also used.

The Microsoft-owned model card confirms the 15B release, MIT license, Phi-4-Reasoning dependency, SigLIP-2 mid-fusion architecture, 16,384 context length, SFT approach, safety post-training, and distribution through Hugging Face, GitHub, and Foundry. The official report says weights, fine-tuning code, and benchmark logs are released and that a portion of training data is planned for a later release. These disclosures do not establish that training records, manifests, synthetic outputs, verification programs, or audit logs are available now.

作者技术报告和 Microsoft Research 发布页直接支持标题、作者、MSR-TR-2026-10 标识、三阶段配方、阶段计数、200B token 表述、数据质量流程、混合推理/直接回答格式、安全数据和公开来源附录。附录列出图文对齐、caption、文档 QA、OCR、数学、CUA 和 RAI 等公开来源类别；报告另行说明还使用了内部和采购数据。

Microsoft 自有模型卡确认了 15B 发布、MIT 许可、Phi-4-Reasoning 依赖、SigLIP-2 中融合架构、16,384 上下文长度、SFT 方法、安全后训练，以及通过 Hugging Face、GitHub 和 Foundry 分发。官方报告称发布了权重、fine-tuning code 和 benchmark logs，并计划稍后发布部分训练数据。这些披露不能证明训练记录、manifest、合成输出、验证程序或审计日志现在已经可得。

title: Novelty
新意
html:
This is not a data release, but it is unusually informative as a frontier construction report. It combines a stage-level multimodal SFT recipe, explicit source-family disclosure, concrete sample/token totals, qualitative data triage, model-assisted repair, image-seeded synthetic transformations, an ablation on mathematics versus computer-use data, and a disclosed 20/80 reasoning/non-reasoning mixture.

Its Track 12 contribution is the contrast between those useful interfaces and the evidence still absent for reuse. The report identifies source families and transformations, but not the actual selected rows, correction prompts, teacher outputs, source weights, rejection yields, detailed rights, contamination checks, or a full data card. It should therefore be compared as a disclosure ledger rather than treated as a complete public recipe.

这不是数据发布，但作为前沿构造报告，它提供的信息异常丰富：阶段级多模态 SFT 配方、明确的来源类别披露、具体样本/token 总量、定性数据分流、模型辅助修复、以图像为种子的合成转换、数学与 computer-use 数据比例消融，以及披露的 20/80 推理/非推理混合。

它对 Track 12 的贡献在于这些有用接口与复用仍缺少的证据之间的对照。报告识别了来源类别和转换，但没有提供实际选中行、纠错提示、teacher 输出、来源权重、拒绝产出、详细权利、污染检查或完整 data card。因此应将其作为披露台账比较，而不是当作完整的公开配方。

title: Limitations
局限
html:
The full training data is not released. Public sources are listed, but their selected subsets, transformations, mixture weights, licenses after modification, and train/validation membership are not. Internal Microsoft and targeted-acquisition data are materially undisclosed. The model card refers readers to an unfilled RRRR_nnnn data-card label rather than an accessible full data card.

Data repair and verification cannot be independently audited. The report names GPT-4o and o4-mini, manual review, and occasional verification or majority voting, but does not release prompts, model versions, sampling, thresholds, correction rates, false-accept/false-reject rates, or rejected records. No contamination protocol or measurements are disclosed. The official Hugging Face model card and GitHub README also contain a faulty citation to arXiv:2511.19663, which is Fara-7B rather than this model's report; the correct primary record is arXiv:2603.03975.

Microsoft notes that the learned reasoning/direct-response switch can be suboptimal, the 20/80 mixture may not fit every domain, and detailed visual understanding remains limited. The model card further warns about English-centric performance, bias, unreliable or fabricated outputs, inappropriate content, and unsuitable high-risk uses.

完整训练数据尚未发布。公开来源虽被列出，但其选中子集、转换、混合权重、修改后的许可和训练/验证成员关系均未公开。Microsoft 内部数据和定向采购数据也有实质性未披露。模型卡引导读者查看未填写的 RRRR_nnnn data-card 标签，而不是可访问的完整 data card。

数据修复和验证无法被独立审计。报告提到 GPT-4o、o4-mini、人工审查和偶尔的验证或 majority voting，却没有发布提示、模型版本、采样、阈值、纠错率、false-accept/false-reject 率或拒绝记录。没有披露污染协议或测量。官方 Hugging Face 模型卡和 GitHub README 还错误引用了 arXiv:2511.19663；该编号属于 Fara-7B，而非本模型报告，正确主记录是 arXiv:2603.03975。

Microsoft 指出，学习到的推理/直接回答切换可能并不最优，20/80 混合未必适合每个领域，细粒度视觉理解仍有限。模型卡还提醒以英语为中心的性能、偏见、不可靠或编造的输出、不当内容，以及不适合高风险使用的情形。

title: Usefulness
用途
html:
For Track 12, the report gives a concrete comparison surface for multimodal post-training disclosure: source categories, data-repair operations, mixed mode tokens, stage curriculum, sample/token totals, CUA and safety coverage, and the distinction between released weights and unavailable training artifacts. It is useful when asking whether a report has supplied enough information to audit synthetic augmentation, correction, selection, feedback, and rights.

The Card should support comparisons with other frontier reports by retaining the asymmetry between disclosed structure and undisclosed instances. It does not classify the model's compute-efficient performance claims as a Track 8 result. Its scope is the evidence needed to decide what can actually be reused, reproduced, or audited from a data and feedback perspective.

对于 Track 12，报告为多模态后训练披露提供了具体的比较界面：来源类别、数据修复操作、混合模式 token、阶段课程、样本/token 总量、CUA 与安全覆盖，以及公开权重与不可得训练工件之间的区别。当需要判断一份报告是否提供了足够信息来审计合成扩增、纠错、选择、反馈和权利时，它很有用。

本 Card 应通过保留已披露结构与未披露实例之间的不对称性，支持与其他前沿报告比较。它不会把模型关于计算效率的性能主张归类为 Track 8 结果；其范围是从数据和反馈角度判断哪些内容实际可复用、复现或审计所需的证据。

title: Reading notes
阅读笔记
html:
• Use MSR-TR-2026-10 and arXiv:2603.03975 as the primary citation; exclude the erroneous 2511.19663 entry in the official model card and repository README.
  • Treat the 200B-token statement and the three stage totals as aggregate recipe evidence, not as manifests or released training examples.
  • Separate reported manual review, GPT-4o/o4-mini repair, and occasional verification or majority voting from an auditable verifier or reward implementation.
  • Keep the disclosed public-source appendix separate from undisclosed internal, acquired, generated, corrected, and selected records.
  • Do not treat the model's 20/80 mode mix, mode-switch behavior, benchmark scores, or public weights as proof of a generally reusable training pipeline.

• 使用 MSR-TR-2026-10 和 arXiv:2603.03975 作为主引文；排除官方模型卡和仓库 README 中错误的 2511.19663 条目。
  • 将 200B token 表述和三个阶段总量视为汇总配方证据，而不是 manifest 或已发布训练样例。
  • 将已报告的人工审查、GPT-4o/o4-mini 修复以及偶尔的验证或 majority voting，与可审计的 verifier 或 reward 实现区分开来。
  • 将已披露的公开来源附录，与未披露的内部、采购、生成、纠正和选中记录区分开来。
  • 不要把模型 20/80 模式混合、模式切换行为、benchmark 分数或公开权重当作普遍可复用训练流水线的证明。

value.html: Public vision-language sources listed in the report appendix, plus undisclosed Microsoft domain datasets and targeted acquisitions; final source weights, internal data, and acquired-data terms are unknown.

Image and text context with task prompt; reasoning records contain <think>...</think> chain-of-thought before final answer, while perception-oriented records begin with <nothink>. Grounding coordinates are normalized relative to image dimensions.

Public source authors plus synthetic/corrected records. GPT-4o and o4-mini regenerate some answers/captions and are sometimes used in verification or majority-voting pipelines; prompts, allocation, and outputs are unknown.
Three-stage multimodal SFT: MLP image-text alignment, full-model single-image instruction tuning, then long-context/multi-image/RAI specialization.

No RL reward or executable training verifier is disclosed. Quality control includes manual dataset review, GPT-4o/o4-mini answer or caption regeneration, and where appropriate model verification or majority voting; implementations and calibration are unknown.

Excellent data is generally retained; datasets or records with wrong answers, poor captions, low-quality questions/images, or formatting/logical errors are corrected, repurposed, or excluded. Exact thresholds, dataset-level decisions, and rejected logs are unknown.
Phi-4-Reasoning language-model backbone plus SigLIP-2 vision encoder, connected by a mid-fusion MLP projector.
GPT-4o and o4-mini for some answer/caption regeneration and, where appropriate, verification or majority voting; full teacher policy is unknown.

Programmatic synthetic text-rich image data, regenerated captions/answers, detailed image descriptions, caption/VQA derived from existing images, and multi-image/screenshot transformations; exact generator mapping is unknown.

Stage 1: 2.0M samples/1.4B tokens; Stage 2: 62.8M/188.5B; Stage 3: 3.2M/12B. Stage 2 is mixed single-image instruction tuning; Stage 3 specializes in long context, multi-image, and RAI. Per-source sampling weights are unknown.

Manual classification of data quality; retain excellent records, correct wrong answers/poor captions, exclude high-error datasets and fundamentally flawed images, and repair formatting/logical errors. Full criteria, prompts, thresholds, and yields are unavailable.
Official model card reports 16,384 context tokens and up to 3,600 visual tokens. Evaluation uses greedy decoding, temperature 0.0, and 4,096 max output tokens; these are not training settings.

Stage 1 trains only MLP; Stages 2 and 3 train MLP, vision encoder, and language model. All stages use AdamW, bf16 mixed precision, DeepSpeed ZeRO-1, and one epoch. Learning-rate values and full optimizer configuration are unknown.

Public sources in the report appendix include Bunny, Pixmo, LLaVA-OneVision/NeXT, Docmatix, Open Images, IAM, NuminaMath, OpenThoughts, MMR1, Eedi, AGUVis, MultiUI, BigDocs, PhiGround, SeeClick, WebSight, Hateful Memes, Think-in-Safety, WildGuard, M4-Instruct, VisualWebInstruct, and VLGuard; the mixture also includes undisclosed internal and acquired data.
Training/validation split membership and source-level partitioning are unknown. Public benchmark evaluation is described separately from the training mixture.
